snippet.title: Spider Land | A Very Dark Apocalyptic Visual Novel Game | PC
snippet.description:
Spider Land | A Very Dark Apocalyptic Visual Novel Game | PC
#visualnovel #gaming #indiegame #atmospheric #dark #apocalypse 

Buy Game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246230/Spider_Land/

A nuclear war was the best thing that ever happened to me.
In the aftermath of total annihilation, one man blossoms, finally set free from the shackles of morality. Spider Land is a visual novel about that man. Once a doomsday prepper, now a scavenger. Life is simple. Eat, sleep, maybe kill if it comes to that, repeat.



During the day, you spend your time communicating with a disparate network of survivors. Nobody can see your face through the computer, and that's just how you like it.

Come nightfall, you emerge, ready to make the most of what little this world has to offer.

Choose from a myriad of landmarks to survey, all housing unique characters and dangers aplenty. Make decisions that will have far reaching implications. Maintain your grip on reality by any means necessary. Then, when the sun comes up, return to your bunker and sleep the events of the night off.

Just give a me a reason. All I need is a reason.
